scope: Independent artifact-only static/algorithm audit. The fixed-array C++ helper was translated faithfully into JavaScript and compared with the distinct-prefix word DP. No C++ compilation, patched-WASM execution, production edits, or GitHub mutations.
findings: Each full EAN13 word has a unique digit/parity table path; saturating path counts at two therefore counts distinct words correctly. Future suffix validity depends only on parity/checksum state, and after adding the leading digit only on checksum residue.
Exact shared float variance operations and strict initial threshold preserve baseline first-min selection. No epsilon or different-precision equality was introduced.
Pattern shifts are at most 19, left array indices at most 639, right array indices at most 9, and promoted additions are capped before uint8 conversion. Space/time are fixed and bounded.
Final row rejection occurs after optional add-on parsing and Require handling, preserving the baseline final cursor. Checksum-error results and explicit UPC-A-only converted results bypass rejection.
limitations: Static inspection and translated-algorithm agreement do not prove C++ compilation, ABI, compiler float behavior, or actual patched-WASM decoding.

The 942-profile study covers EAN13 only, max255, minLineCount2, add-on Ignore, full resolution with downscale disabled. It cannot validate production max1/2, enabled downscale, other UPC/EAN families, or mixed-format scenes.
The diagnostic ports expose maxSymbols but do not implement all C++ early-exit or skip-vertical control flow. They must not be reused to validate max1/2 without a fresh exact baseline check.

Preserved row cursor prevents additional searches inside the consumed symbol, but row rejection can change adjacent check-row scheduling, line-count overlap competition, max-symbol early exit, vertical scanning and later inversion/downscale passes. Global output-subset or no-expanded-search claims are unproven.
EAN13-format rows can encode UPC-A/ISBN aliases. Explicit UPC-A-only conversion bypasses this candidate; mixed/all-format requests can retain EAN13 internally and be filtered.
